cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: a place where you can read or borrow books. The library is by the park.
library card · /ˈlaɪbrɛri kɑrd/ · noun · Phrase · New
A card that lets you borrow books from a library. Show your library card at the desk.
a person who works in a library and helps people use it. The librarian helps me find a book.
borrow a book · /ˈbɑroʊ ə bʊk/ · phrase · Phrase · New
To take a book temporarily and give it back later. Can I borrow a book from this library?
return a book · /rɪˈtɝn ə bʊk/ · phrase · Phrase · New
To give back a book that you borrowed. Please return the book on Friday.

articulation.label: library
articulation.alt: library: /l/ → /aɪ/ → /b/ → /r/ → /ɛ/ → /r/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
/b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
